title: Average of Levels in Binary Tree
statement_short: Given the root of a binary tree, return the average value of the nodes on each level in the form of an array. Answers within 10^-5 of the actual answer will be accepted.
constraints: 1 <= number of nodes in tree <= 10^4, -2^31 <= Node.val <= 2^31 - 1
hint: Node count up to 10^4 permits level-by-level summation using a level-order queue traversal.
keywords: average value of the nodes on each level
why_not: Right: Tree BFS computes the sum of node values at each level and divides by level size in O(n) time and O(w) space. Not Tree DFS: DFS aggregates level sums using level-indexed lists, but BFS processes levels sequentially in memory. Not Prefix Sum: Prefix sums calculate range totals over arrays rather than level aggregates across binary trees. Not HashMap / Hash Set: Mapping levels to sums in a map works, but queue-based level processing is the natural BFS structure.
